sample_unit: cases (300 LiveQA-Med, 300 PubMedQA, 256 ESI triage), each scored 3 times per model

links.outcome: Under-triage of ESI level 1 (Resuscitation) cases by LLM evaluators
links.effect: ESI level 1 cases were under-triaged in 89.1% of evaluations, across all 10 models (range 70.2%-96.9%).
links.quote: In the highest-stakes task, ESI level 1 (Resuscitation) cases were under-triaged in 89.1% of evaluations, in all 10 models (range 70.2%-96.9%).

links.outcome: Stability of LLM-evaluator performance across different medical tasks versus human reference labels
links.effect: No model ranked top 3 on all 3 tasks; every model shifted 3 or more rank positions between at least one pair of tasks. Best triage kappa 0.60 [0.54, 0.66].
links.quote: Evaluator performance was unstable across tasks: no model ranked in the top 3 on all 3 tasks, and every model shifted by 3 or more rank positions between at least one pair of tasks.

unlisted_practices: Task-specific validation of LLM-as-judge evaluators against human reference labels before deployment

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation assessing LLM-as-a-judge stability across three distinct medical evaluation/triage tasks; it evaluates model capabilities rather than comparing an implemented organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
